crossRefs.note: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness…
Then I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire; from the appearance of his waist and downward, fire; and…
For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,
for our God is a consuming fire.
His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

translations.web: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.
translations.bsb: From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. And from what seemed to be His waist down, I saw what looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded Him.
translations.kjv: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
translations.asv: And I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it round about, from the appearance of his loins and upward; and from the appearance of his loins and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness round about him.
